reveal.rule: flooded streets ranked by the distance of their midpoint from the nearest terrain flow path draining more than 20 km2 (data/streets/flow_paths.geojson); an order in space, not in time

methods.label: Official map
methods.drawn_from: the SNCZI zones refetched by pipeline.zones (T10, T100, T500)

methods.label: Our simulation
methods.note: Run with the rain that fell on 29 Oct 2024.

rules.flooded: key A of docs/STREETS.md: at least half of the piece in the EMSR773 observed flood (flooded area or flood trace) or a surveyed water mark above 0 m within 10 m
rules.zone: at least half of the piece in an SNCZI zone (any of T10, T100, T500); the class named is the most frequent one that holds half the piece
rules.simulated: at least half of the piece where the SIMULATED run (rain on terrain, 25 m, measured rain of 29 Oct 2024, no infiltration) is deeper than 0.3 m
rules.pieces: OpenStreetMap ways of 28 Oct 2024 (Overpass, the queries of results.json streets.inputs.osm) cut into pieces of about 25 m, scored when the midpoint lies in one of the 10 towns and in the area EMSR773 analysed

check.not_rebuilt: the permanent water mask and the terrain's no-data cells of the scores (they only leave out pieces on water)

marks.what: water heights surveyed after the flood (MEASURED), above 0 m, in the 10 towns: lon, lat, depth in m

sources.flood: Copernicus EMS EMSR773, observed flood of 3 first-response maps (© European Union)
sources.marks: Institut Cartogràfic Valencià, Generalitat Valenciana, DANA 2024 service, CC BY 4.0
sources.simulated: the team's rain-on-terrain run (PR #39), streets flagged from the run's own raster (sim_hmax_25m.tif)
sources.upv: UPV street depth map of the 2024 flood (Roch Talens et al. 2025, doi 10.7203/CGUV.114-15.32144), median depth over the stretch
sources.buildings: Copernicus EMS EMSR773 grading of damaged buildings (© European Union), within 25 m of the stretch
